Name: Ridable Bike
Author: aobo11
Description:
This mod turns your horse into a bike, Not totally finished, as i want to change the sound it makes and maybe make you pedal with the bike. That last one is a little advanced for me as the sprites are pre-set so if anyone knows a fix, let me know.
Other things i could use help with
*changing horse sounds without changing player walking sounds
*Changing the hitbox to make it smaller

Other than that i hope you like it, It really did seem kind of weird having a horse in stardew when noone else has one, this fits in a little better i think.
